scenario: The ego vehicle swerves right to avoid a braking passenger car and then collides with an illegally placed hazard obstacle in the roadway.

ego.behavior: The car drives forward, swerves right to avoid a braking vehicle ahead, and then collides with an obstacle in the right lane.

adversarials.behavior: The passenger car brakes suddenly in the same lane ahead of the ego vehicle, causing the ego to swerve.

spatial_relation: On a multi-lane city street at night, the ego vehicle follows a passenger car in the same lane, with an illegally placed hazard obstacle sitting directly in the right lane where the ego swerves.
requirements_and_restrictions: The scenario occurs under nighttime low-visibility conditions; the ego vehicle must avoid the braking car but ultimately collides with the illegally placed obstacle in the right lane.

road_side_structures.position: Visible on the right side of the road near the obstacle area.

temporary_modifications.position: Illegally placed directly in the right lane of the roadway where the ego vehicle swerves.

reasoning_chain: 1. Actors: The ego is the camera-host vehicle from dashboard view; the braking car ahead is the adversarial. 2. Chronology: Initially ego follows car at distance. Midpoint car brakes hard with bright red taillights. Ego swerves right to avoid. Ending ego hits blue-lit obstacle in right lane. 3. Evidence: Car's taillights illuminate brightly indicating braking; ego's lateral position shifts right; obstacle appears stationary with reflective blue surface in right lane at collision point.
